thread:
sophia: 🎉 Hosted API v2 is GA — streaming, tool-calling, and new model variants are live in hosted. Rolling to all customers over next 24h. Docs + migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/hosted-api-v2

devops-bot: deploy started: hosted-api-v2 canary -> us-west-2 (10% traffic)

ajay: awesome! any breaking changes to the HTTP surface? SDK bump?

sophia: No breaking changes to /v1/generate. New endpoints: /v1/stream (server-sent events) and /v1/tools for tool-calling. SDK releases: npm @redwood/inference@2.0.0, python redwood==2.0.0

marc: when do old streaming beta endpoints get deprecated?

sophia: Beta endpoints deprecated on 2026-05-15. Migration guide here: https://redwood.ai/migrate/streaming-beta

jess: Pricing / rate limits — any changes for GA?

sophia: No consumer tier changes. We've added an enterprise burst quota option and per-tenant concurrency controls. Pricing details: https://redwood.ai/pricing/hosted

infra: Canary telemetry: p95 latency +12% for llama-rx-3b under long-context tests. Auto-scaler triggered additional pods. Investigating KV cache warmup.

devops-bot: rolling rollback threshold set: p95 > 1.2s for 5m -> rollback canary

ajay: sample streaming call for engineers? can we include curl example?

sophia: Sure — paste into terminal to see SSE stream:

`````
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "redwood-turbo-1.1", "input": "Summarize the doc"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
`````

helpdesk-bot: Support playbook created: https://redwood.ai/internal/playbooks/hosted-api-v2. Includes troubleshooting for tool-calls and malformed function responses.

marc: Do we want a short KB article for customers about tool-calling permissions?

jess: I'll draft and pass to legal for data policy review.

sophia: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with product notes and an all-customer email tomorrow 09:00 PST. Ping me for questions. :rocket:
